negative_snippets: Poor customer service , staff was rude and can definitely improve a lot by being nice to customers.

Long stays not possible here. No ventilation anywhere in the entire building, not a single window anywhere. The building is new.  a property dealer on the first floor, a gym at the second and OYO at the third floor. The gym owner locks the main gate from the outside. We ordered tea from Chaayos at 11pm and to our surprise, we found that we were locked up inside the building. There was no way anyone could go out even in the case of medical emergencies.
. Not suitable for family and night stay... No main door keys, No wash room lock, TV is not working, wardrobe doors are hanging, no AC remote and so on.....
